entities.summary: Tatsuya Yoshida (b. 1961-01-09, Kitakami) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kitakami and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
